id.description: Primary key for the book record.

user_id.description: The user ID of the person who published the book.

dataUrl.description: The URL to the book's JSON data file.

imageUrl.description: The URL to the book's cover image.

chapterCount.description: The number of chapters in the book.

fileSize.description: The size of the book's JSON file in bytes.

uploadedAt.description: The timestamp when the book was uploaded.

originalFilename.description: The original filename of the uploaded book.
